name: LangGraph PostgresStore (long-term memory store)
description: Cross-thread LangGraph BaseStore in PostgreSQL with namespaced JSON items; optional pgvector semantic search; optional TTL with a background sweeper. Package langgraph-checkpoint-postgres.

provenance.notes: Supports version 3.2.0 (uploaded 2026-10-14). The 3.2.0 wheel's langgraph/store/postgres/base.py defines ttl_config, an expires_at column, sweep_ttl() and a docstring requiring start_ttl_sweeper() for expiry: supports_ttl true, conditional on the sweeper being started.

Supports memory_type long_term (cross-thread store, namespaces, put/get/search/delete) and that semantic search is optional ('configure the store with an embedding model'); backing_type relational is the item's primary backing. Vector search when enabled uses pgvector in the same PostgreSQL.
